}}{{TIDTOC|adapter}} ==Overview== "M01-UG265-X20" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
This FCC ID also covers the [[AboCom WUG2654|WUG2654]] - a model with a 4 MB Flash chip on-board (presumably for mass storage mode for auto driver installation).
The FCC operational description includes a block diagram for the device. :The RFIC is specified as an '''RFMD''' RF2959. :The PA module is specified as an '''SiGe''' SE2525L.
